title: VPC Service Controls: a perimeter around the data

videos.script: A credential is stolen. To IAM, the thief looks exactly like you. {{stolen}} VPC Service Controls asks a different question. Not who you are, but where the request comes from, and where the data is going. {{where}} A perimeter is a line around projects. Inside it, Cloud Storage and BigQuery answer only requests from inside, or from places you named. And data cannot leave, unless a rule cut a hole for it. {{perimeter}} Turning it on blind breaks a job nobody remembered. So it starts in dry run, and you read what it would have refused. {{dryrun}} This one needs an organisation, so it is read, and planned, not run. {{end}}
